units: <cite ref="Berakhot 58b:5">Ber. 58ᵇ</cite> <he>וכ׳ אתכם בדין וכ׳</he> and provided for you (while alive) in justice, and gathered you in justice.

senses.gloss: (cmp. כְּלִילָא) to raise a crown of hair, to be a nazir.
units: Naz. I, 1 הריני מְכַלְכֵּל I will grow a crown (as a substitute for, ‘I will be a nazir’, v. כִּינּוּי). Y. ib. 51ᵇ top כאומר הריני מן המְכַלְכְּלִין as if he said, I will be one of those who wear a crown of hair.—
<cite ref="Tosefta Niddah 6:6">Tosef. Nidd. VI, 6</cite>; <cite ref="Niddah 52b:19">Nidd. 52ᵇ</cite> <he>עד שתְּכַלְכֵּל</he> (euphem.) until she has a full growth of hair (around the pudenda).

senses.gloss: denom. of כֶּלִי) to arm, fit out.
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 7:17">Midr. Till. to Ps. VII</cite> <he>א״ל הקב״ה ולא אני כלכלתי בה</he> (read: <he>כִּלְכַּלְתּיו</he>) said the Lord to him (Doëg), is it not I that fitted him (David) out with it (the sword of Goliath deposited in the Sanctuary)?—[The entire sentence is missing in ed. Bub.; note 69 a. l. quotes fr. mss. <he>קלקלתי</he>.]
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 4:1">Pesik. R. s. 4</cite> <he>אליהו נ׳ וכ׳</he> (not <he>נתבלבל</he>) Elijah was supported by the woman of Zarephath.
